description: Finite official policy serving/deployment, training/evaluation, demonstration-data and hardware-control workflow entrypoints. Python source is statically reviewed, referenced and never executed by the Hub. This is not an exhaustive project or internet inventory.
refresh_policy: Review every changed commit, source byte pin, license scope, author/setup document and per-entrypoint label manually. The importer performs offline rebuilds by default; --fetch explicitly verifies only the existing frozen text pins. Do not install upstream packages or download checkpoints/meshes to refresh this registry.
